pr_title: TabContainer: Fix error on removing top-level Control child, Remove _get_tab method
pr_body:
Fixes error on removing top-level child `Control` from `TabContainer`. In #45123 only a check against `Control` was added but a non-top-level `Control` is also not considered as a tab and thus it's not connected to `renamed` signal in the first place.
Errors can still arise if user would change `top_level` property of a child `Control` of a `TabContainer` because in such situation logic from `add_child_notify()`/`remove_child_notify()` wouldn't be applied and thus `renamed` signal could be correctly/incorrectly connected/not connected to the callback. But it's rather uncommon case. To prevent/solve it properly something like https://github.com/godotengine/godot-proposals/issues/3081 would be needed.
Fixes #35741.

Removes private `_get_tab()` method as `get_tab_control()` does exactly the same thing.

In `move_child_notify()` prevents updating tabs when a non-tab child `Node` was moved (as suggested in https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/45123#issuecomment-758548517). Also there's no need to defer the call to `_update_current_tab()` because `move_child_notify()` is called after child was already moved (contrary to `remove_child_notify` which is called before removal happens).

Does some other cleanup.
pr_comments: This will likely need a dedicated PR for `3.x`, since it won't apply cleanly there.

issue_context.title: Freeing TabContainer with direct child of type AnimationPlayer produces Error
issue_context.body:
**Godot version:** 3.2 Stable

**OS/device including version:** Win 10

**Issue description:**
Freeing TabContainer with direct child of type AnimationPlayer produces following Error
``` 
_disconnect: Nonexistent signal 'renamed' in [AnimationPlayer:3588].
  <C++ Error>   Condition "!s" is true.
  <C++ Source>  core/object.cpp:1518 @ _disconnect()
```

If AnimationPlayer is a grandchild of TabContainer, error does not come up.
**Steps to reproduce:**
Run Attached Project, main scene has two instanced child scenes, one with direct child AnimationPlayer which produces error on queue_free, and one with AnimationPlayer as grandchild ( a Control inbetween ) which produces no error on queue_free.


**Minimal reproduction project:**
[animationplayerbug.zip](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/files/4134326/animationplayerbug.zip)
comments:
Can reproduce error in 3.2.2.stable on linux mint 18.3.

However, is your minimal reproduction project set up as you intended?

![Godot35741_Screen](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/64640811/87418229-3f573680-c5c9-11ea-92f9-5b016ca61cba.png)

As I said it still produces the error, but the grandchilded AnimationPlayer seemed an important detail in your description.
The error should not occur if the animation player is a grandchild of the tabbed container but with a control parent.

Still happens with 3.2.4.beta.custom_build. 2d904127d
```
ERROR: _disconnect: Attempt to disconnect a nonexistent connection to signal 'renamed' in [AcceptDialog:2723], with target '_child_renamed_callback' in [TabContainer:2786].
   At: core/object.cpp:1569.
```
Automatic minimal project
[RegressionTestProject.zip](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/files/5875380/RegressionTestProject.zip)
Happens on any control as well if you set it to `drag_to_rearrange_enabled` and drag a tab. Seems like any time you remove a node will force disconnect `rename` signal even if it hasn't been set.

review_comments: This one looks like a typo made in https://github.com/godotengine/godot/commit/fc9077a213e8a73137855b41fda99819e7d1af85, everywhere else `is_set_as_top_level` is used.
